name: SensibleButtonMsg
meaning: Messages handled by SensibleButton_HandleMessage 0x4f044c (sender must be non-NULL) and sent by its Update.

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: -> 0x27 SHEEP_ATTR_BUTTON to any sender (0 for TYPE 14): buttons are sheep attractors. The Wolf never sends msg 2 to a button (registry flag 1 is clear)

name: MSG_SWITCH_ON
meaning: sent every frame while occupied, arg = occupants[4]

name: MSG_SWITCH_OFF
meaning: sent every frame while empty, arg 0

name: MSG_BUTTON_LOCK
meaning: arg 1: lock and show pressed; else unlock and show up
